content:
Maria K.: Heads-up: TallShip reported a p99 latency spike starting ~11:12 UTC for their Dedicated pool. Support attached traces and a short customer repro. Can eng-runtime triage async?

support-bot: Incoming incident bundle: https://inbox.redwood/support/tallship/incident-4521 (trace + logs + config).

Devin L.: Got it. Quick questions — is this visible across multiple regions or just us-east-1?

Maria K.: Only us-east-1 so far per their report. Spike is small (2x p99) but sustained ~20m.

Jon P.: Possible rolling change earlier today? Kernel selector rollout at 10:50? @Devin L.

Devin L.: I saw a canary flip around 10:47 but rollout didn't complete. Will check rollout logs.

Priya S.: I can run a profiling pass on the Dedicated pool for TallShip. Planning: capture 2 mins of pprof CPU + wall traces at p99 window. Will create a bench run: `benchctl run --customer tallship --samples 300 --mode spike`

Claire R.: Also check KV cache hit ratio, we've had regressions when prefix cache TTL fell to default. Query: `SELECT * FROM cache_metrics WHERE customer='tallship' AND ts > now() - interval '1 hour'`

Devin L.: Copy. Running quick query now.

Devin L.: KV hits dropped from 87% -> 45% at 11:10, matches timeline. Batching also shows average batch size down from 8 -> 2.

Maria K.: Interesting. Could be a routing change sending small requests or cache invalidation. Any recent prefix cache config changes?

Jon P.: Kernel selector diff touched batching heuristics last deploy. I'm going to diff commit `a7f3d2e` -> `b1c7e4f`.

Jon P.: Patch note: we accidentally disabled `allow_batching_on_short_seq` for some model variants. That would explain batch size drop.

Priya S.: If batching dropped, per-token overhead increases -> p99 spike. I'll capture profiles focused on scheduling/dispatcher. Running: `ssh infra@node-7 'sudo perf record -F 99 -a -g -- sleep 120'` then `pprof --base /tmp/tallship.pprof`

support-bot: Customer repro (sanitized) attached: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" https://api.redwood/tallship/generate -d '{"prompt":"...","max_tokens":512}'`

Devin L.: I pulled node logs: saw many `serialize_request` syscalls blocked waiting on `mmapped` region. Might be GC-ish in allocator.

Claire R.: Can we confirm whether kernel selector change affects quantized kernels? We had a fallback path that added memcopy for q4_0 -> q8 conversion earlier. That causes memcpy at runtime.

Jon P.: Right — that fallback was introduced in b1c7e4f for certain model shapes. If batching broke, we hit more model variant fallbacks which trigger the memcpy.

Maria K.: Action items: (1) Priya to upload pprof & flame graphs; (2) Jon to open rollback PR for kernel selector tweak; (3) Devin to collect node-level perf + cache metrics and pin us-east Dedicated pool to older kernel selector if needed.

Priya S.: Uploading profiles now: https://profiles.redwood/tallship/pprof-1839999999.tar.gz :eyes: Includes CPU, heap, and dispatcher traces.

Devin L.: Node perf dump: `/tmp/tallship-node7-perf.data` uploaded to S3 `s3://redwood-debug/tallship/1839999999/node7.perf`

Claire R.: Quick grep of pprof shows heavy time in `memcpy` and `dispatch::route_request`. Also KV miss storm at the same timestamps.

Jon P.: I opened rollback PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/5123 — reverting batching heuristics change. Can we coordinate a canary rollback to us-east-1?

Maria K.: Support: please warn the customer we're investigating and that we may do a controlled rollback; keep them updated.

support-bot: Notified customer: "We're investigating a transient latency spike; we'll follow up with mitigation steps and timeline."

Devin L.: I'll kick a controlled canary rollback in 15m to one Dedicated shard, validate p99.

Priya S.: If rollback not possible, we can also temporarily increase batch window (config override) as a mitigation: `runtime.config.batch.window_ms=30` -> that'll allow batching to rebuild.

Maria K.: Great. Keep this thread updated with validation numbers. If canary rollback reduces p99 back to normal, plan to rollout revert and then schedule a follow-up to reintroduce batching tweak with tests.

Jon P.: Can confirm: canary rollback started. Rolling to shard us-east-1a only.

Devin L.: Canary results after 10m: p99 down from 620ms -> 190ms on shard. KV hit ratio climbing back to ~85%. Looks like rollback fixed it.

Claire R.: Nice. I'll file a postmortem note about the config gate that should've prevented disabling batching for short sequences.

Maria K.: Thanks everyone. Priya, save the traces under the incident bundle path and I'll close the loop with TallShip in the support ticket.

Priya S.: Traces saved to incident bundle. Adding a short note to the PR with analysis.

Devin L.: Leaving a final check: increased monitoring alert thresholds, and added a temporary rule to block the problematic kernel selector rollout until tests cover batching behaviour. :white_check_mark:

Maria K.: Closing async triage — will convert to postmortem if customer requests. Great work. :tada:
